convert_edgetam_checkpoint: convert an EdgeTAM checkpoint to HuggingFace transformers format and save locally
get_config: build an EdgeTamVideoConfig with RepViT backbone and default prompt encoder and mask decoder settings
replace_keys: transform original SAM checkpoint keys to HuggingFace-compatible state dictionary keys
run_sanity_check: test the converted model with a sample image and point prompts to verify output scores
push_to_hub: upload the converted model and processor to a HuggingFace Hub repository
